virtual_key_id.description: Virtual key ID associated with this connection

connected_at.description: Time when the connection was established

last_activity_at.description: Last activity time for this connection

groups.description: Groups this connection is subscribed to

user_agent.description: User agent string from the client

messages_sent.description: Number of messages sent to this connection

messages_acknowledged.description: Number of messages acknowledged by this connection

idle_time.description: Gets the time since last activity

DiscoveredModelDto.description: A model returned by the Conduit discovery extension.

source_ip.description: IP address that requested the ephemeral key

user_agent.description: User agent that requested the ephemeral key

purpose.description: Purpose or intended use of the ephemeral key

EphemeralKeyMetadata.description: Optional metadata for tracking ephemeral key usage

ephemeral_key.description: The ephemeral key token to use for authentication

EphemeralKeyResponse.description: Response when creating an ephemeral key

function_configuration_id.description: The function configuration ID to execute.

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the function.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to associate with the execution.

oneOf.description: Optional metadata about the ephemeral key request

GenerateEphemeralKeyRequest.description: Request for generating an ephemeral key

expiration_minutes.description: How many minutes the URL should be valid (1-10080).

GenerateUrlRequest.description: Request to generate a temporary download URL.

GroupConnectionDto.description: A connection projected for group diagnostics.

GroupConnectionsResponse.description: Connections attached to a SignalR group.

HubConnectionDto.description: A connection projected for hub diagnostics.

ModelMetadataDto.description: Effective metadata for an enabled model mapping.

ModelParametersResponse.description: UI parameter metadata for a model.

VideoGenerationTaskResponse.description: Response for async video generation task creation.

VideoGenerationTaskStatus.description: Status information for a video generation task.

VirtualKeyConnectionDto.description: A connection projected for virtual-key diagnostics.

VirtualKeyConnectionsResponse.description: Connections attached to a virtual key.
